════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
🌌  UNIVERSE-FORGE WIZARD — HIGH-LEVEL APP SPEC
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
OVERVIEW
The wizard lets a creator type a single **PrimaryTheme**.
Gemini then auto-generates every world-building module (Seed → Future)
by referencing three knowledge sources we provide:

  1. Ten JSON Schemas    – shape & validation for each module
  2. Master Glossary     – short definitions for every formal term
  3. Module Playbooks    – prose guidance for each module
                           (lexicon, patterns, linkage, example)

We are giving you *all three* as static assets.  
Your job is to scaffold an app that:

  • Presents one PrimaryTheme input
  • Calls Gemini for the Seed module
  • Iterates through the nine remaining modules,
    always sending Gemini:
        – the universe JSON so far
        – that module’s schema
        – the relevant glossary slice
        – that module’s playbook text
  • Shows a final preview and a “Download JSON” button

No hand-coding from the human side; generate everything needed.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FOLDER PLAN (names only — you decide the file formats)

src/
  /schemas/01_Seed.json … 10_Future.json      ← we’ll paste after scaffold
  /knowledge/
       glossary.json                          ← list of {term, definition}
       lexiconIndex.json                      ← map moduleKey → [terms]
       modules/                               ← 10 docs: Seed.md, Duality.md …
  /ai/                                        ← prompt builders & Gemini helpers
  App component & minimal UI

Use any stack that compiles in Firebase Studio (React + Vite is fine,
but you can choose).  Tailwind for styling if convenient.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
AI-CALL LOGIC (conceptual, not code)

1. On “Forge” click:
      • Build **Seed prompt**:
            – PrimaryTheme
            – Seed.md playbook
            – glossary slice for Seed terms
            – Seed schema text
      • Send to Gemini → parse JSON → add to universe.

2. For each remaining moduleKey in
      [Duality, Cosmic, World, Culture, SocioEcon,
       TechMagic, FineDetails, Characters, Future]:
      • Build “Next-module prompt”:
            – Current universe JSON (read-only)
            – playbook for that module (.md file)
            – glossary slice (lexiconIndex)
            – schema text for that module
      • Gemini returns JSON → merge into universe.

3. After Future:
      • Render pretty-printed universe JSON
      • Provide “Download” button (Blob → save as universe.json).

Validate each Gemini response against its schema.
If invalid, show an error toast and stop the chain.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DELIVERABLES WE EXPECT FROM YOU (Gemini)

1. Project skeleton with folders exactly as outlined.
2. Stub assets:
      – glossary.json  → include one sample entry so we see the shape
      – lexiconIndex.json → include two sample mappings
      – modules/*.md    → include Seed.md with one sample paragraph
3. A placeholder wizard component that:
      – already contains the AI-call loop *in pseudocode comments*,
        ready for us to paste our API key and schemas.
4. A README in the repo root titled *“How to Add Real Data”*
   explaining where to drop:
      – the ten JSON schemas
      – the full glossary data
      – the nine remaining module playbooks

NO line-level implementation is required from the human after this brief.

Generate the scaffold now.
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
